blurb:
Come see Nashville on a 1.5- or 2.5-hour Segway tour. Tours start and end a couple blocks from lower Broadway. Bachelorette parties and groups welcome! 

1.5-HOUR MUSIC CITY SNAPSHOT TOUR
Travel around the entertainment district and take in sights such as Ascend Amphitheater, Schermerhorn Symphony Center, Country Music Hall of Fame, Bridgestone Arena, the Ryman Auditorium, and more. This tour is perfect for first time riders, experienced riders on a time crunch and those stopping by Nashville for a day! Begin with a 30 min training session before heading out for an hour of fun!

2.5-HOUR DOWNTOWN TOUR
We'll take you 5 miles through Nashville covering such landmarks as the Schermerhorn Symphony Center, Country Music Hall of Fame, Bridgestone Arena, Fort Nashborough, Bicentennial Mall, Farmer's Market, and the Tennessee State Capitol. We'll cover areas most tours can't get to, because you're on your very own Segway! Tour has a 30 min training session followed by 2hr Segway tour!
